method.dispersion: Grimme D3, Becke-Johnson damping, two-body (vdw_corr=dft-d3, dftd3_version=4, dftd3_threebody=.false.)
method.cell: fixed at the X-ray values (294 K), Pc, Z = 2, 54 atoms
method.relax: BFGS, forc_conv_thr 5e-4 Ry/bohr, etot_conv_thr 1e-5 Ry, conv_thr 1e-8 Ry (upscale 100)

chosen.rule: cheapest setting within 1 meV/atom and 1e-3 Ry/bohr of the most converged one tested; cutoff not below the SSSP-recommended 60/480 Ry

convergence.E_ii_minus_i_note: E(ii) - E(i) at the unrelaxed starts (X-ray N-H 0.86-0.90 A vs O5-H 0.98 A): used only for its convergence with cutoff; the physical energy difference is in periodic_qe.json
convergence.pressure_note: pressure_kbar: PBE-D3(BJ) stress of the X-ray (294 K) cell with the deposited, unrelaxed H positions (X-H 0.78-0.93 A, too short), so it is large and positive and says nothing about the cell; only its convergence (dP_kbar) is used.  The meaningful pressure is the one at the relaxed ions (periodic_qe.json, pressure_kbar_final)

comparison.verdict: the O5-protonated start (ii) relaxes back to the salt (proton on N1): single minimum

constrained_neutral.what: start ii relaxed with H1A (both formula units) fixed in space where start ii puts it (0.98 A from the X-ray O5, on the N1->O5 line); N1 and O5 relax, so read the final d(N1-H1A) and d(H1A-O5) in proton.  Result: the floating origin of Pc let every other atom slide (mean_shift) until N1 re-bonded to the fixed H1A, so this is a salt (see constraint_held); superseded by iirfix.
constrained_neutral.WARNING: the proton of relax_iifix ended on N1 (N1-H1A 1.0679 A): this is a salt structure, NOT the neutral form; E_iifix_minus_i is not a neutral-salt energy difference

constrained_neutral_iirfix.what: relax_i with H1A (both formula units) moved 0.98 A from O5 on the N1->O5 line, then relaxed with H1A AND O5 fixed in space (O5-H1A held at 0.98 A; pins the floating origin).  A constrained structure, not a minimum: an upper bound to the energy of the neutral (O5-H) form in the lattice.

method.functional: PBE0 (input_dft=pbe0, 25% exact exchange), SCF single points at the PBE-D3(BJ) relaxed geometries (fixed X-ray cell, no re-relaxation), k grid of the relaxes (2x1x1)
method.dispersion: D3(BJ) two-body (dftd3_version=4, dftd3_threebody=.false.); QE 7.5 takes the parameters from the functional (get_dft_short -> dftd3_xc -> setfuncpar): pbe0 {"s6": 1.0, "a1": 0.4145, "s8": 1.2177, "a2": 4.8593}, pbe {"s6": 1.0, "a1": 0.4289, "s8": 0.7875, "a2": 4.4407} (dft-d3/core.f90, tag qe-7.5; verified numerically against simple-dftd3, d3_check)
method.pseudopotentials: variant sg15_*: SG15 ONCV v1.2 norm-conserving PBE (Schlipf & Gygi, Comput. Phys. Commun. 196 (2015) 36; no nonlinear core correction), ecutrho = ecutfock = 4 ecutwfc; the hybrid correction is added to the SSSP PBE-D3(BJ) difference.  Variant sssp: the relax potentials (G-space augmentation).  Why SG15: see the periodic_qe.py docstring (cost of US/PAW exact exchange; QE 7.5 tqr bug)
method.exact_exchange: ACE (adaptively compressed exchange, QE default ace=.true.); q mesh nqx per variant (default 1x1x1); exxdiv_treatment 'gygi-baldereschi' + x_gamma_extrapolation; EXX converged when dexx < conv_thr
method.units: meV per cell (54 atoms, Z = 2); kJ/mol per formula unit = per cell / 2
